description: Admin actions: restart (soft reboot, ~1 min offline), ota_upload (file = local path of the firmware package the fleet tool made for THIS controller - GIGA/Opta (4.x): MYIO_UPD.BIN, uploaded to the SD card, or internal flash without a card; Due (3.12+): MYIO_NEW.BIN, SD card only, checked before upload: a raw Arduino build or a package made for another controller is refused), ota_apply (the controller installs the uploaded package and restarts; a GIGA/Opta rolls back by itself if the new image fails, a Due keeps its running firmware if the package is rejected), ota_restore (GIGA/Opta only: go back to the previous image). The answer waits for the controller to come back and reports the running version and the outcome. Needs MYIO_WRITE=admin.
name: myio_system
title: Restart / firmware update
